slides.title: HVAC owners: 4 dates you can't let lapse before the winter rush
slides.body: First cold night = every phone ringing at once.

slides.title: Contractor license
slides.body: Renews on its own schedule. Some states want CE hours done first.

slides.title: Liability insurance + COI
slides.body: Property managers and GCs often want a current one before you start.

slides.title: Workers' comp
slides.body: Hiring extra techs for the cold snap? Make sure coverage keeps up.

slides.title: Van registrations
slides.body: Every truck in the fleet, each on its own date.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: Check all four before the first freeze.
